_comment: M4 Gemini-request reasoning: with reasoning.supported=false any supplied thinkingLevel is a diagnosed loss; strict rejects pre-IO with 400 TRANSLATION_LOSS and zero upstream requests (supported-false gate runs before the named-effort branch). GREEN on baseline status/IO; guards gate order.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "gem-chat"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"

[capabilities.overrides."gem-chat".reasoning]
supported = false
name: m4_reasoning_gemini_chat_supported_false_strict
